reviews.text: Very caring and supportive

Very pleased with Towerwood Vets, the nurse who did Rosie’s 6 month Health Check was excellent, very considerate and gentle as Rosie was very nervous. A very good experience,
Thank you.

We always feel welcome and all the staff are lovely.  Appointments are not rushed and we always have time to discuss any problems we may have with our pets. We can always get good advice over phone if any problems. Would highly recommend this vets.

Friendly, professional, & caring staff who always go above & beyond to help. I have travelled to this practice since 1991 & wouldn’t trust anyone else with my much loved dogs
Great practice never change

The vet nurse I saw yesterday is definitely telling a cat whisperer! Gave a worming tablet singlehandedly and my difficult cat swallowed it first time too. A 'first' at the practice.
Because the cat is hard to catch the practice is patient when I have to miss, then make repeated appointments, as long as I let them know about 15 minutes beforehand.
4 stars only because of unknown diagnoses/prices in general.

First visit with our new puppy and everyone we met was lovely and took great care of him and us. Really helpful with advice and answering my many questions as a first time dog owner. We choose the practice on a recommendation and would recommend on to others.

Absolutely amazing vets — I couldn’t recommend Towerwood Vets enough!

Jake and the whole team at Towerwood Vets were absolutely incredible when my pug needed life-saving surgery. Jake went above and beyond to help us through what was an incredibly worrying and stressful time, and I’m so grateful for everything he did.

Every member of staff we dealt with genuinely cared about our dog, and that really showed in the way they treated him and supported us. Their compassion, professionalism and dedication were outstanding.

We honestly can’t thank Jake and the whole Towerwood team enough for helping save our boy. ❤️🐾

Absolutely amazing vets and highly recommended!

Thank you Catherine, please let us know how we can improve your visits to us. We want to offer you the best in clinic experience possible as all of our team care about the best pet experience whilst we are looking after you.

We have only been with Towerwood for a few months but every appointment with them has been great. Absolutely everyone on the team we have met - receptionists, nurses, and vets - have been exceptionally kind and patient. We haven't felt pressured at any point and the team have been happy to answer any questions in detail and act immediately on any admin requirements.

Using the pet health club has been really easy and so far has seemed cost effective. We also really appreciate the number of free check-ups provided after surgery to ensure Ants has been healing as required. And it's an added bonus that the practice has a separate waiting area upstairs for cats to reduce the stress of a vet trip.

A lovely practice with a team who all show a clear passion for animal care, though we hope not to have to see any of you for a while!

Very happy with the care given to my cat .
She went in for her vaccine and the vet gave her a thorough check over and weighed.

Every time I have come with concerns for my dog, they have been so helpful. They don’t pressure you, I’ve never had pet insurance and so they have always been accommodating with helping me find ways to pay for treatments, making sure my dog is well cared for.
Very understanding and kind.

I visited Brendan, the holistic vet for the second time. Very impressed by the improvement in my dog without using antibiotics and steroids and with a plan to move forward.
Brendan and his team are friendly, caring and highly efficient. I would, and have recommended him to friends.

Used to be a great vets but since being bought out they have gone down hill. Prices have risen to a ridiculous level and quality of care has dropped even for routine appointments. I would no longer feel comfortable taking my cats here for any health problems.
On top of that their marketing strategy leaves a sour taste in my mouth - sending out emails for "offers" on unnecessary cat care appointments and making auto-booked appointments on your behalf. I have had to block them on multiple channels now despite not using them for over a year.

This was our first visit. All the staff were welcoming and friendly. Huckleberry is a nervous dachshund but I was reassured all the way through that they thought he was a great little dog. Throughly recommend

My dog Bob is now 12 and has more complex needs especially around mobility. He has not tolerated standard pain meds and to give him some relief, Brendan has helped explore other treatments for pain relief from acupuncture, McTimoney to help re-align his spine, CBD oil (Towerwood is registered to advise about this), physiotherapy and more.
He is supported by a phenomenal team of helpful, friendly recetionisists, nursing staff and an experienced veterinary team.
Brendan is also more than helpful in collaborating with practitioers and vets closer to me as we travel a little way to get to Towerwood vets. This is especially helpful for Bob, but also for me.

Amazing personal and efficient  service and genuine love and care for each and every pet.  All staff from receptionists, to nurses to vets all very knowledgeable  explain stuff thoroughly and love the animals

I would never recommend Towerwood Vets based on my experience.

I lost all confidence in the practice due to repeated poor communication and a lack of professionalism. The final straw came when my dog's histology results, which could’ve been cancerous, were not communicated to me. I had to chase the practice three separate times before anyone contacted me, and when they finally did, they referred to my dog by the wrong name. At what was an incredibly stressful time, this demonstrated a complete lack of care and attention to detail.

As a result, I transferred my dog to another veterinary practice over a year ago. Despite this, I continue to receive letters, emails and text messages from Towerwood Vets, which I have found both frustrating, harassing and unacceptable. It raises serious concerns about how patient records and client communications are managed in line with GPDR regulations.

For me, trust is everything when choosing a veterinary practice, and unfortunately Towerwood lost mine. I cannot recommend them based on the level of care and administration I experienced. Shocking!

A good blend of conventional and holistic medicine. My dog is particularly nervous which presents as aggression but they treat her like she is the sweetest thing!
I would recommend these vets and note people travel from all over the country to have their pets under the care of Towerwood.
Luna is shy around new people. But the staff allways manage to handle her well.
Lovely welcoming staff, the vets really seem to care about your pet and are happy to discuss available treatments and what is best for your pet. You are not forced into costly treatments.
good experience

Tower wood vet & nurse were amazing when my 18 year cat needed pts - they did a home visit  which was perfect as he was at home with no stress  & went very quietly  😢 would definitely recommend them  - thank you so much 🥰 …
My kitten was been sick & withdrawn straight after visiting the vet she was back home & eating. Vet was lovely with her.  Highly recommend
Very helpful staff, explained everything, vet was very understanding about my dogs needs, the vet nurse was very good

It's was Oreo's first vet visit for his 1st round of shots and chipped. He handled it like a champ purring the whole time. The vets were really informative and lovely I'd highly recommend them to anyone with a furry family member.
Wonderful team and very clean and beautiful premises. Luckily my cat is fine but I would trust this practice with any occurrence.

Rating: ⭐ (1/5) – I would give 0 stars if I could

A full ovary was left inside my cat Silvie during her spay. She suffered for months and needed a second major surgery.
Towerwood refused to to take responsibility.

I trusted Towerwood Vets to perform a routine spay on my beloved cat, Silvie. What should have been a straightforward procedure turned into a nightmare.

Months later, Silvie began showing intense, repeated signs of being in heat – something that should have been impossible after a correct spay. She was distressed, restless, and uncomfortable. I was constantly worried about her.

Eventually, a second opinion at another vets revealed the horrifying truth: a full ovary had been left inside her. This was confirmed during an invasive exploratory surgery and later by a histology report.

Because of this error, Silvie had to endure a second, major abdominal surgery – cutting her open again, extending her recovery, and putting her through unnecessary pain and risk. The months of 'super heat' cycles left her exhausted and confused.

When I tried to raise this with Towerwood Vets, they refused to take responsibility. They passed my complaint to their insurer (VDS), who tried to minimise what happened. I never received a genuine apology or even an acknowledgment that my cat had suffered because of their mistake. They also refused to refund the original spay – and to be clear, this was never about the money. It was about what they had done to Silvie, and their refusal to admit it.

The physical and emotional toll on Silvie has been devastating. Watching her go through two surgeries and months of distress has been heartbreaking.

I would strongly caution anyone considering this practice. They failed my cat, and they failed to show any real accountability.
They take so much care of our pets. Lots of understanding.

Really promising - Brendan was full of good and helpful, but manageable ideas that we’re starting to implement. Critically, for us, he took a holistic approach - which is what we feel has previously been bypassed. It’s just the beginning of a process but we’re very optimistic. He was brilliant with our slightly nervous bull terrier and put her at ease - thank you

Lovely friendly understanding staff our first appointment and felt very welcomed and valued. My fur babies were looked after and treated with love and care . I would definitely recommend this vet to everyone x
They look after our two cats, always impeccable service

First visit yesterday to Towerwood vets, called with my 15 year old Lhasoapso his paws had slit with previous on going problems, got him in straight away, Brendan was great totally felt they was not money driven like most vets these days, as most up sell medications. Also they try more the natural healing route too

Always a good experience visiting Towerwood vets at Cookridge. The team are really friendly and take the time to listen to your any concerns you might have regarding your pet and provide solutions that work. I now have friends who use Towerwood after my recommendation and they are also really happy with the service they get.

Needed an emergency appointment to see the vet, we rang towerwood vets greengates who booked us in with the cookridge team, the team was really helpful, and we was in and out within 30 minutes, with the medication needed.
I volunteer for a fox rescue charity and sadly I collected a dead Fox. The vets are amazing. Very friendly,  helpful and accommodating. Thank you so much for your help today it was truly appreciated.
Great support and treatment of our Labrador dog.
Took my cat in for a dental extraction, took really good care of him and it didn't cost too much
Always happy to help chatty and welcoming
Towerwood vets are amazing very friendly and helpful in any situation nothing is too much trouble I would recommend them to anyone looking to register a new fur baby.
Very professional staff, warm welcome, big thank you to Natalia for advices - I hope our fur baby will get soon!
Very expensive now. £85+ to vaccinate a cat.
Lovely receptionist on arrival. Reception area very clean and tidy. Vet was lovely and friendly and very informative. Nurse that assisted vet was just fab.
Friendly and caring

NEGLECT IN CARE FOR MY DOG ARTHUR GOULD - DISPLAYING CLEAR SIGNS OF PARVO - he was dying - MATTHEW did not look after him correctly and he also referred to him as IT - CLEAR NEGLIGENCE - complained and no response yet

I can't speak highly enough about this vets! Sadly my beautiful girl hit the bridge yesterday evening, they tried everything they couldn't and the mounting bill felt like it had slack! We had been with a large mainstream vet and 4 my mistakes I think we wasted time and more so money as everything was far more expensive! Support the independents and our other girl will go nowhere else. Thank you for trying and most of all, for caring

Used to use Towerwood religiously but my last 2 visits with guinea pigs have been poor, with both ‘consultations’ essentially recommending I take them to Holly House Exotics (which I do anyway, I just couldn’t get an appointment soon enough as he needed seeing). If your staff aren’t experienced enough to deal with certain animals, don’t offer appointments for those animals (and charge for a ‘consultation’ which suggests you go elsewhere). Don’t worry Towerwood, I will be doing from now on. 2 stars given rather than 1 because the staff behind the desk were lovely and pleasant.

What can I say
These vets and staff  are absolutely fantastic.
Pandora the bunny is a firm favourite with the staff.
They have seen us a few times in the last few weeks, due to Pandora's own cet not doing dental treatments.
Pandora has been a star patient even yesterday when he had a tooth removal which hopefully will be fine.

Travelled to Leeds specifically for dog vasectomy - not many places offer this. Excellent service from zoom consultation to discuss procedure before booking, to pet and owner care. They deserve their outstanding RCVS status for client care. I would take my dogs here if I lived locally. Thank you to all at the practice.
Thank you for your review.
Helpful vet who explained clearly what she was doing and my options. Treated dog with care.

These vets are fantastic, they helped a lot with one of our dogs who was seriously ill. We had been to a previous vet that just didn't listen to what we were saying and caused more problems. Towerwood saved  our dogs life, very grateful.
Always polite and friendly , really clean inside and out , attentive to your pet i definitely would not change my vets

Its all about the money, insurance.
It has taken me over 6 months to be able to write this review. My poor cat Mavis was seen 3 times by Iris a vet, last October to December 2024. Mavis was hiding, losing weight and her paw was clearly not well. Degloved I was told. I visited a 4th time and requested a different vet. Diagnoses, Mavis has cancer. It was clearly too late. No blood tests offered to confirm. £2,500 bill to investigate.  Heatbroken at the lack of treatment or empathy Mavis recieved. I will never take a pet to this practice again.

I would definitely continue to recommend TowerWood! All the staff members are friendly and in the couple of appointments / health checks we have had I have always felt listened to and that I have been given enough information to make an informed decision. Booking appointments is really easy on their website and when I needed a same day appointment they were really helpful, they have some good monthly pet health programmes which are really useful.
Peggy also love a trip to the vets because she’s always made such a fuss of! Thanks Towerwood!

I have every confidence in the vets at Towerwood Vets.Milo my Ridgeback/ MastiffX is 14 yrs of age and has Arthritis in his rear left leg and goes every month for his injection . The staff are brilliant and when my Late  Border Collie / Grmn Shepherd X went she would always sit on the bench with me making noises ( Greeting anyone who walked through the main door). Sadly Aleisha passed nearly 6 yrs ago .  My pussycat Tizzy passed 3 yrs ago  and the vet was very kind and agreed Tizzy had passed to Saddle Thrombosis.
Very professional and helpful. Very confident leaving my Dog there and he always wags his tail when going in. Would recommend to friends.

We had our first visit to Tower Wood this morning with our 10 week old puppy, the vet who saw us was so lovely and patient with him (and us!). we can definitely see ourselves sticking with this practice for as long as we can, especially with their pet health plans seemingly saving money in the long run.

The vets are great but the prices are extortionate! 38 quid to send you a prescription. Also they would only give out a prescription for half the time as my previous vets while charging 50 percent more

Amazing forward thinking veterinary practice.    We travel down from Scotland every year to get our two dogs health checked and address any issues that may arise.   It is so refreshing to be able to discuss all the different approaches to treatment and care using an holistic approach knowing we are helping to give our dogs the very best of care and a happy healthy life.

We are very satisfied with the services of this veterinary office, they take care of all animals very attentively and caringly. We made a good choice to choose this office even though it is 30 minutes from our house. 🙏👏🏻 …

Speedy appointment,  warm welcome and very professional service.
Brendan explained things very thoroughly and was very helpful.
Don’t understand how our cat could die two days after an appointment here… feel like the issue wasn’t taken seriously enough :(
As always, very friendly staff. But most of all,  when it comes to helping my boy, Bailey,  I'm blown away with the level of professionalism that's being done to help my pet
Excellent service from start to finish thank you!

Knowledgeable and helpful vets practice, I did the puppy program which was excellent and then signed up to the monthly plan for our dog covering check ups and regular worming / flea treatments. Works well and nice to have the cost spread across the year rather than a  bill I have to pay each time
find the vets  --and -assistants all very helpfully verry nolagable yes it's expensive  but  it's your choice  if you wish to go ahead with the offered treatment

Terrible experience. Not the first time to have issues but this is getting too much. Every time i visit they increase price. Took there more than 20 kittens and there was issues more times and never could be sorted by them. Last one i booked for vaccination and got a full price on phone, double checked more times for all 3 kittens, and after they got the first vaccine i was told it is double. So supposed to pay 214 extra which is not acceptable and the only thing they can do is say sorry and can not do anything about it. The phone conversations are recorded so could have checked that who told this false information but did nothing. Going for just the money. Would not recommend at all!

Amazing practice with outstanding staff! The genuine care and commitment from all the staff from front of house reception through to vets given to the pets is fantastic, and they always go the extra mile. Andra is an outstanding vet who went above and beyond looking after my boy following a complex op-  she gave personal tailored care to my boy consistently checking in and  genuinely cared about my dog- thank you so much Andra! Reception make a point of knowing your pet and giving them a warm and reassuring welcome when they arrive. They even have a rabbit specialist, Nurse Lucy, who is amazing with all pets! Thank you, Towerwood, for being a fantastic practice with staff bending over backwards to help owners and their furry babies!

Review from our visit in October. We managed to get a last minute appointment to see the Vet with our poorly hamster. Unfortunately she had to be put down but the Vet we saw was very compassionate and allowed us time to say goodbye which …
Lovely friendly staff, they care so much about the animals and their owners. Clean well looked after premises and fair prices. They even sent a condolences card when we had a pet die.
Amazing welcoming all round animal caters .I have no faults and  In one word brilliant.
